This scene:
神农和他的家人住在古代，所以不知道什么植物能吃。因为他的家人常常生病了，所以神农和他的哥哥一起去旅行找可以吃的植物。他们去很多不一样的地方，比方说高山、山谷和沙漠。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 神农和他的家人住在古代：better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
- 因为他的家人常常生病了：常常生病，no了for routine/habit
- 他们去很多不一样的地方：去了，了completed

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 住在古代：生活在古代，住在 usually takes a place as its complement, while 生活在 can describe living in a historical period. [rule: word_choice]
2. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农：有一位叫神农的人，This is the character’s first mention, so introduce him with a full noun phrase rather than assuming the reader already knows who he is. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
3. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 常常生病了：常常生病，A habitual action or state with 常常 uses the zero particle; 了 is for a completed action or change of state. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
4. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 他们去很多不一样的地方：他们去了很多不一样的地方，The visits to these places are completed events in the narrative, so the verb needs 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
5. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 所以不知道：不知道，Living in an ancient period establishes the time setting; it does not by itself express a cause-and-effect relationship, so 所以 is not needed. [rule: none]

items.reason: “住在古代” is acceptable Chinese here, although “生活在古代” is another possible wording.
This is the first mention of the character, so the teacher requires an introducing noun phrase.
常常 describes a habitual situation and should not take completed-event 了.
The trip to the places is a completed narrative event, so 去 needs 了.
所以 can appropriately link the ancient-time setting with not knowing which plants were edible.
